summary: Iteration 6 verified — 41/41 backend pytest pass (added 9 new tests across TestIteration6EventFormConfig, TestIteration6IndividualValidation, TestIteration6TeamValidation, TestIteration6AdminEditEvent). Three pre-existing tests (test_create_registration, test_admin_registrations_list, test_create_session_and_status) updated to include the now-required extras.why_join field — these failed before the fix because Mock Stock now requires it. Backend per-event form-builder is fully functional: GET /api/events returns Mock Stock with registration_mode='individual' + 2 extras (why_join textarea required, has_demat yesno optional) and Situational with mode='team', tmin=3, tmax=5, 1 optional team_tagline extra. POST /api/registrations correctly validates per-mode: missing extras.why_join → 400, missing team_name → 400, members below tmin → 400 'Team must have between 3 and 5 members', per-member missing fields listed as 'members[i].field'. Admin can PUT /api/events/{id} to flip mode/team_size/eligibility/extra_fields and changes persist. Frontend EventDetailPage: Mock Stock renders all individual-mode fields including reg-extra-why_join (textarea) + reg-extra-has_demat (Yes/No select); submission with extras.why_join → 'Registration received' + goto-payment-btn. Situational renders team form with reg-team-name, reg-member-{name,school,grade,phone,email}-{0,1,2}, reg-add-member adds member-3, reg-member-remove-N removes; valid 3-member submission with extras.team_tagline succeeds. Eligibility text now per-event: Mock Stock shows 'individual competition - one student, one portfolio' and Situational shows team eligibility — confirmed both via UI scrape and via event.eligibility field on API. Admin /admin → Events tab: row-mode-{i} Select, row-save-{i}, ExtraFieldsEditor with extra-row-{i}, add-extra-field, new-event-mode all visible and functional (verified after admin login).
action_items: Fix the PytestReturnNotNone warning in TestRegistrations::test_create_registration (line returns reg_id; should drop the return statement).

Consider running an idempotent backfill on existing events on startup to ensure registration_mode/team_size_min/team_size_max/eligibility/extra_fields fields exist on any event created before iteration 6 (currently the seed only runs when the events collection is empty).
critical_code_review_comments: register_for_event in server.py is now ~150 lines with mode-specific branches and email-rendering inlined; consider extracting validate_mode(event, body) and build_email_rows(event, body) helpers.

EventItem.extra_fields uses List[dict] instead of List[ExtraField] — bypasses Pydantic validation on the embedded extras (Admin can POST malformed fields like type='unknown' and it will save). Recommend typing as List[ExtraField].
register_for_event uses `int(event.get('team_size_min', 2))` — if admin saves a string, cast may KeyError or ValueError. Coerce safely or validate at PUT /api/events/{id} time.
Frontend AdminPage.jsx EventRow is rendered for each event but only saves changes when row-save is clicked — there is no dirty/unsaved indicator, easy for admin to lose edits when navigating away.

The startup seed only inserts the two events when count == 0; after iteration 6 if a developer manually wipes events MongoDB will reseed only the original two — no idempotent upsert for the new fields if the events doc already exists in old shape.
